pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are irregularly polygonal with rounded vertices. Edge transitions display smooth pixel gradients likely due to atmospheric haze or resolution. Patches on the flank are significantly larger in spatial area compared to the elongated patches on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light negative-space pathways form a continuous, interconnected network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. Pathways maintain a narrow, uniform pixel thickness across the flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the superior neck line and shoulder region.
